description: Listed Building Consent for retention of internal and external works, including:1. Basement (Utility / Bedroom)Installation of a partition timber stud wall to create two separate rooms and a new enclosed cupboard space.2. Ground Floor (Kitchen-Dining Room)Continuation of panelling and cornices across the original opening between the kitchen and dining room.3. First Floor (Study / Living Room )Installation of a single panelled door and panelled partition between the study and living room.4. Second Floor (Bathroom)Installation of a new cupboard built into the existing layout.5. Third Floor (Studio / Bedroom)Installation of a run of cupboards located between the front and rear rooms, creating enclosed storage along the partition line.6. External WorksInstallation of an iron grill over the pavement light well, situated at the front of the property.
